project.name: Assistant Updates
project.description: Fixes and enhancements for the WLJ Personal Data Query System identified during comprehensive audit. Includes critical bug fixes, missing integrations, and feature completions.

tasks.name: Fix is_deleted Filter Bug in Journal Data Query

description.objective: Remove the broken is_deleted=False filter from get_journal_data() since is_deleted is a property, not a field, and the SoftDeleteManager already excludes deleted records
actions: Open assistant/data_service.py
Locate get_journal_data() method around line 219
Change 'queryset = JournalEntry.objects.filter(user=self.user, is_deleted=False)' to 'queryset = JournalEntry.objects.filter(user=self.user)'
Update the docstring comment from 'filter by user and exclude soft-deleted' to 'filter by user (SoftDeleteManager excludes deleted records)'
Update corresponding test in test_data_service.py to verify filter is called with only user parameter
description.output: get_journal_data() method uses correct filter that relies on SoftDeleteManager, tests updated and passing

tasks.name: Integrate Personal Data Query with AI Personal Assistant

actions: Open apps/ai/personal_assistant.py
Import process_assistant_message from assistant module
Identify where user messages are processed and system prompts are built
Call process_assistant_message() with the user object and message

tasks.name: Add Integration Tests for Personal Data Query System

description.objective: Create integration tests that use real Django models and ORM to verify the Personal Data Query System works correctly with actual database operations
actions: Create new test file assistant/tests/test_integration.py
Use Django TestCase (not unittest.TestCase) to get database access
Create test user and real model instances
Test get_weight_data() with actual WeightEntry records
Test get_journal_data() with actual JournalEntry records
Test get_medication_data() with actual MedicineLog records
Test get_food_data() with actual FoodEntry records
Test get_mood_data() with actual JournalEntry records with mood
Test soft delete behavior - verify deleted records are excluded
Test date filtering with real date ranges
Test process_assistant_message() end-to-end
description.output: Integration test file with 15+ tests covering real ORM operations, soft delete behavior, and full pipeline

description.objective: Create tests that verify caching behavior with Django's cache framework rather than mocks
actions: Add tests to assistant/tests/test_integration.py or create test_cache_integration.py
Use Django TestCase with override_settings to use locmem cache
Test that query results are cached after first call
Test that cached results are returned on second call
Test that cache is invalidated when model save signal fires
Test that cache is invalidated when model delete signal fires
Test cache TTL behavior
description.output: Integration tests verifying cache hit/miss and signal-based invalidation with real Django cache

description.objective: Enhance cache invalidation to handle date-specific cache keys more comprehensively, preventing stale data for specific date range queries
actions: Research Django cache backends that support pattern-based deletion (Redis with delete_pattern)
If Redis available, implement pattern-based invalidation: personal_data:{user_id}:{data_type}:*
If not Redis, implement cache versioning approach - add version key per user/data_type
Update _generate_cache_key() to include version number
Update invalidate_user_data_cache() to increment version instead of deleting specific keys
Add configuration setting for cache strategy (pattern vs versioning)
Update tests for new invalidation approach
Document the cache strategy in code comments
description.output: Cache invalidation properly clears all date-variant cache keys when data changes, with configurable strategy for different cache backends

description.objective: Document the soft delete handling pattern for the Personal Data Query System to ensure future data methods follow the same approach
actions: Add a section to docs/wlj_claude_troubleshoot.md about SoftDeleteManager
Document that models inheriting UserOwnedModel automatically filter deleted records
Document that using is_deleted in filter() will cause FieldError
Add inline comment block at top of data_service.py explaining soft delete pattern
Add example code showing correct vs incorrect filtering
Reference this documentation in CLAUDE.md quick reference
description.output: Documentation in troubleshoot.md and data_service.py explaining soft delete pattern, preventing future bugs
